canvas.$description: Survey field book — dark cool technical plate (direction role: canvas). Target AAA chrome on this ground. Not Broadcast surface-deep.

field-ink.$description: Survey field book — near-white graphite (direction role: ink). Named field-ink so HUD --color-ink stays light during dual-token period. ≥7:1 on canvas for play labels.

field-ink-muted.$description: Survey field book — secondary copy (direction role: ink-muted). Keep ≥4.5:1 on canvas; play chrome prefers field-ink.

flag.$description: Survey field book — fluoro survey orange (direction role: flag). Primary CTA / active tool / stake chips only (~≤15%). L retuned for dark plates + AAA with flag-ink.

flag-ink.$description: Ink on solid flag fills for AAA play chrome. Do not pair with flag-soft on dark canvas — use field-ink on soft washes.

flag-soft.$description: Soft flag wash for chips / selected chrome on dark plates.

signal.$description: Survey field book — cool blue (direction role: signal). Info / sync OK — always pair with label/icon.

signal-soft.$description: Soft signal wash on dark plates.

trail.$description: Survey field book — green (direction role: trail). Success / in-zone — always pair with label/icon.

trail-soft.$description: Soft trail wash on dark plates.

halt.$description: Survey field book — red (direction role: halt). Error / dead session — always pair with label/icon.

halt-soft.$description: Soft halt wash on dark plates.

rule.$description: Survey field book — hairline edge (direction role: rule) visible on dark plates for status/island borders (≥3:1 non-text).
